answer: Hillside water rights cannot be photocopied. A candidate stakes 8.40 POA and draws one carved marble sluice on a seed-chosen terrace for 13 minutes. They must lift that gate and flash an 18-bit optical signal of gate-id, pubkey, and epoch seed down a 62 m flume so two ridge clocks accept only a 9.4-10.6 ms transit. 90 aliases would freeze 756 POA and need 90 exclusive sluices. Wardens replay the terrace draw from the seed and confirm one gate is occupied. A reused sluice, a copied signal, or a transit off by more than 0.5 ms burns 46% of the stake and rests that terrace for five epochs.
